question: Rajendra Chola I is known for his naval expeditions on the revived Sri Vijaya empire of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajendra Chola I, a prominent Chola king, is renowned for his naval expeditions and military successes in Southeast Asia.
 
• He led successful naval campaigns against the Sri Vijaya Empire, which was based in modern-day Indonesia, particularly in Sumatra and the Malacca Strait.
 
• The Chola navy was considered one of the strongest during its time and played a pivotal role in expanding the Chola Empire’s influence overseas.
 
• Rajendra Chola I’s expeditions aimed to establish trade supremacy and a cultural foothold in Southeast Asia.
 
• Through these campaigns, the Cholas managed to ensure control over important maritime trade routes that connected India with Southeast Asia and China.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Chola Empire and its Naval Strength:**

 
 
• The Chola Empire (9th–13th century) was one of the most powerful South Indian dynasties, known for its administrative efficiency, temple architecture, and extensive trade networks.
 
• The Chola navy was instrumental in establishing and maintaining the empire’s dominance over the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean trade routes.
 
• The expeditions to Sri Vijaya marked a high point in the Cholas’ maritime history, showcasing their ability to project power far beyond the Indian subcontinent.
